question.nlq: I would like to list the names of customers who have made payments exceeding one thousand dollars.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'name' I refer to the customers' given names, that is, the first name they were assigned at birth, not their family names.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_first_name
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
  AND ft.transaction_amount > 1000;
